'''Yuri Vladimirovich Yakovlev''' ({{langx|ru|Юрий Владимирович Яковлев}}; born April 29, 1952) is a Russian intelligence officer, head of the Economic Security Service of the [[Federal Security Service|Federal Security Service of the Russian Federation]] (2008–2016), deputy general director of the [[Rosatom]] State Corporation (since October 10, 2016), and holds the rank of [[Army general (Russia)|General of the Army]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.vesti.ru/article/1953918 |title=В Салехарде прошло заседание ФСБ по защите интересов России в Арктике // Вести |access-date=2020-10-22 |archive-date=2020-10-24 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201024221036/https://www.vesti.ru/article/1953918 }}</ref>

==Biography==
In 1975, he graduated from the [[Moscow Engineering Physics Institute]], specializing in Experimental Nuclear Physics. After graduating, from 1975 to 1976, he worked as an engineer at the [[Lebedev Physical Institute]] of the [[Academy of Sciences of the Soviet Union]].

From 1976 to 2016, he worked in operational and management positions in state security agencies. From 2004 to 2008, he served as the first deputy head of the Economic Security Service of the [[Federal Security Service]], and from 2008 to 2016, as the head of this structure. In his position, he also headed the FSB Coordination Council for the Protection of National Interests of the Russian Federation in the Arctic. In June 2016, he was dismissed by [[Decree of the President of Russia|decree]] of the [[President of Russia]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://meduza.io/news/2016/06/08/glava-sluzhby-ekonomicheskoy-bezopasnosti-fsb-uydet-v-otstavku |title=Глава Службы экономической безопасности ФСБ уйдёт в отставку // Медуза |access-date=2018-01-06 |archive-date=2018-02-16 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180216025147/https://meduza.io/news/2016/06/08/glava-sluzhby-ekonomicheskoy-bezopasnosti-fsb-uydet-v-otstavku }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.kommersant.ru/doc/3011906 |title=Экономическая безопасность ФСБ станет собственной // Коммерсант |access-date=2018-01-06 |archive-date=2019-12-24 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191224162221/https://www.kommersant.ru/doc/3011906 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://meduza.io/feature/2016/06/20/chto-oznachayut-kadrovye-perestanovki-v-fsb |title=Что означают кадровые перестановки в ФСБ? Отвечает эксперт по силовым структурам Андрей Солдатов // Медуза |access-date=2018-01-06 |archive-date=2018-02-16 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180216025145/https://meduza.io/feature/2016/06/20/chto-oznachayut-kadrovye-perestanovki-v-fsb  }}</ref>

From 10 October 2016 he served as Deputy Director General of the [[Rosatom]] [[State corporation (Russia)|State Corporation]] for State Policy in the Field of Security in the Use of Nuclear Energy for Defense Purposes.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.forbes.ru/biznes-photogallery/340743-sem-generalov-fsb-v-bolshem-biznese-ot-kandaurova-do-feoktistova?photo=6 |title=Семь генералов ФСБ в большом бизнесе: от Кондаурова до Феоктистова // Forbes |access-date=2018-01-06 |archive-date=2018-02-15 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180215204211/http://www.forbes.ru/biznes-photogallery/340743-sem-generalov-fsb-v-bolshem-biznese-ot-kandaurova-do-feoktistova?photo=6  }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://defence.ru/article/fsb-perekhodit-na-rabotu-v-rosatom/ |title=ФСБ переходит на работу в «Росатом» // Ольга Тонких |access-date=2018-01-06 |archive-date=2018-02-16 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180216025109/https://defence.ru/article/fsb-perekhodit-na-rabotu-v-rosatom/ |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://meduza.io/news/2016/08/05/byvshiy-glava-sluzhby-ekonomicheskoy-bezopasnosti-fsb-pereydet-na-rabotu-v-rosatom |title=Бывший глава службы экономической безопасности ФСБ перейдёт на работу в «Росатом» // Медуза |access-date=2018-01-06 |archive-date=2018-02-16 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180216025026/https://meduza.io/news/2016/08/05/byvshiy-glava-sluzhby-ekonomicheskoy-bezopasnosti-fsb-pereydet-na-rabotu-v-rosatom  }}</ref>

On 12 February 2023, amid the [[Russian invasion of Ukraine]], he was included in the sanctions list of Ukraine because "Rosatom's management sent its employees to Ukraine along with Russian military personnel who seized the Ukrainian nuclear power plants - [[Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant]] and [[Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant]]".<ref>{{Cite web|language=ru|url=https://sanctions.nazk.gov.ua/ru/sanction-person/1173/|title=ЯКОВЛЕВ Юрий Владимирович - биография, досье, активы|website=Война и санкции|access-date=2023-05-20|archive-date=2023-05-20|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230520234650/https://sanctions.nazk.gov.ua/ru/sanction-person/1173/}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|language=ru|url=https://theins.ru/news/259329|title=Зеленский ввел санкции против 200 россиян.
